num_patients: <int> Total number of patients on the shared waiting list requiring surgery.
num_hospitals: <int> Number of collaborating hospitals in the network.
num_days: <int> Number of days in the planning horizon.
num_ors_per_hospital: <int> Number of identical operating rooms available at each hospital.
num_mandatory_patients: <int> Number of patients whose health status score meets or exceeds the mandatory threshold.
num_scenarios: <int> Number of equally likely scenarios representing uncertain surgery durations.

global_parameters.kappa_1: <int> Per-unit benefit earned when a patient is scheduled for surgery.
global_parameters.kappa_2: <int> Per-unit penalty incurred when a non-mandatory patient is postponed to a future planning horizon.
global_parameters.kappa_3: <int> Per-unit cancellation cost applied to non-mandatory patients whose scheduled surgery is cancelled.
global_parameters.kappa_4: <int> Per-unit cancellation cost applied to mandatory patients whose scheduled surgery is cancelled.
global_parameters.Gamma: <int> Health status score threshold at or above which a patient is classified as mandatory.
global_parameters.duration_mean_minutes: <float> Mean of the truncated lognormal distribution used to generate surgery durations, in minutes.
global_parameters.duration_std_minutes: <float> Standard deviation of the truncated lognormal distribution used to generate surgery durations, in minutes.
global_parameters.duration_truncation_low_minutes: <float> Lower truncation bound for surgery durations, in minutes.
global_parameters.duration_truncation_high_minutes: <float> Upper truncation bound for surgery durations, in minutes.

patients.alpha_p: <int> Number of days the patient has been waiting since referral.
patients.rho_p: <int> Urgency rating of the patient, where higher values indicate greater urgency.
patients.omega_p: <float> Health status score computed from the patient's waiting time and urgency rating.
patients.is_mandatory: <bool> Whether the patient must be scheduled within this planning horizon.
patients.c_sched_per_day: <dict, key: '{day_label}'> Scheduling benefit for assigning this patient to surgery on each day of the planning horizon.
patients.c_unsched: <float> Penalty incurred if this non-mandatory patient is postponed to a future planning horizon.
patients.c_cancel: <float> Penalty incurred if this patient's scheduled surgery is cancelled on the day of surgery.

hospitals.num_ors: <int> Number of operating rooms at this hospital.

days.day_id: <int> Zero-based index of the day within the planning horizon.
days.day_label: <int> One-based label of the day within the planning horizon.
days.B_hd: <int> Maximum available operating time per OR at this hospital on this day, in minutes.
days.F_hd: <int> Cost of opening each individual operating room at this hospital on this day.
days.G_hd: <int> Cost of opening this hospital's surgical suite on this day.

scenarios.scenario_id: <int> Unique identifier for the uncertainty scenario.
scenarios.surgery_durations_minutes: <list[float], length num_patients> Realized surgery duration for each patient under this scenario, in minutes.
